messages.author: bc6140df818f0616
messages.subject: Error digitizing landmarks using digitsurface
parts:
Hi there,

I've been trying to digitise some fixed landmarks with digitsurface() on a humerus' ply.

When I finish selecting all of my landmarks, I get the following error:

Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file 'template.txt': No such file or directory

I went back and tried again with the example scallop ply, and I got the exact same error:

Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file 'template.txt': No such file or directory

I checked and I have the latest Geomorph, rgl, and RRPP versions, so I don't really know how to move forward.

This is the code I used:
library(geomorph)
data("scallopPLY")
my.ply <- scallopPLY$ply
fixed.lms1 <- digitsurface(spec = my.ply, fixed = 4)

Thanks in advanced.

Cheers,
Camilo

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Error digitizing landmarks using digitsurface
parts:
Camilo,

please read the help files a bit more carefully. For digitizing fixed landmarks you should be using digit.fixed(). digitsurface() is used for digitizing surface semilandmarks on surfaces.

The vignette available on the procedure for digitizing 3D data may also be helpful. You can access it running:

vignette("geomorph.digitize3D")

Antigoni
